100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On October 13, 1926, Britain faced a significant political shake-up as Prime Minister Stanley Baldwin announced new elections to resolve ongoing party divisions. In the United States, the stock market showed signs of instability, causing concern among investors as the economy continued to recover from the post-war slump. Meanwhile, in Germany, the government struggled with hyperinflation, prompting further debates on economic reform.
